trap-superlative.notes: NO $L_-$ TERM APPEARS ANYWHERE IN THIS BLOCK. The displayed proton NF is L_+ - (h/2)sigma_0 and the neutron NF is L_+ - h*sigma_0 - (h/2)sigma_1 + (h^2/2)gamma; neither contains L_-.
